interpretation: Fifteen additional full-text comparisons differ after the benchmark normalization. This does not by itself identify which text is wrong: authoritative composition lyrics, aggregator transcripts, and the performance selected by the corpus may represent different editions or repeat/formatting choices. The previous 0/100 means the offline benchmark evaluated no lyric references; it does not mean 100 songs were searched and rejected.
next: Track source coverage separately from correctness. For each source, record attribution, URL, title/artist match, edition binding, normalized hash, and a compact diff classification (exact, formatting-only, wording variant, or unresolved). Promote only after the intended performance scope is established and the text is adjudicated.

lyrics.interpretation: Exact normalized lyric or chord-sequence hash agreement, including a shared hash within a conflicting group, is a consolidation signal, not proof of independent provenance or correctness.
